texts.00462d417ef90dfd401267aa:
You were not born of a janni—your non-human heritage can instead be traced back to some dualistic power between elemental realms.

Requirements: Suli

Benefits: Choose two energy types other than sonic (acid, cold, electricity, or fire). Once made, this choice cannot be changed. You gain racial energy resistance only to the energy types you choose, and not to others. When using your elemental assault ability, you can only sheath your arms in the energy types selected, but you can choose to sheath your primary hand with one of the selected energy types and your off-hand with the other. Attacks made with each hand (or a weapon held in each hand) deal bonus energy damage of the selected type. While wielding a two-handed weapon, half of the bonus energy damage is one energy type and half is the other.
texts.014dcff060786226b06cb145:
Like the red dragons that inspire your tribe, you’re blessed with a small spark of incendiary magic.

Requirements: Kobold

Benefits: You are able to cast spark three times per day as a spell-like ability. The caster level is equal to your character level. This spell-like ability’s save DC is Intelligence-based.
texts.022a4ea8b8529d9d839585fc:
Your family was prominent before the rise of Thrune, but that legacy is now forgotten by all but you. You hold every Chelish government official (including Hellknights) personally responsible for your lost glory.

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack and damage rolls against these officials.
texts.023ce18515d750cdb377c87d:
As a child, you somehow got your hands on a lurid, forbidden text written by a now-forgotten Blood Lord of ages past. You studied the details within intently, learning much about extraplanar undead from beyond this reality, and you developed a strange, almost macabre way of thinking because of this book’s influence.
Requirements: Geb
Benefits: Anytime you would roll a Knowledge (planes) check, you may roll a Knowledge (history) or Knowledge (religion) check instead.
texts.030d36fc82fef3d2e443fc4c:
Growing up, you were exposed to everyday miracles performed by your half-celestial friends, and some of this magic rubbed off.
Requirements: Tianjing
Benefits: At will, you can touch a dying creature to stabilize it as a standard action.
texts.03657905ae4824baed6d375e:
Your grandiose posturing often makes it difficult for anyone to concentrate around you.
Requirements: Sovereign Court
Benefits: Once per day as a full-round action, you may attempt to distract adjacent foes with a lengthy display of your martial prowess. All adjacent foes must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your level + your Charisma modifier) or gain the shaken condition. This condition persists for 1 round.
texts.03fb245a4a5ae335fe69b6ca:
You are both knowledgeable and skilled when it comes to putting together resistance organizations, thanks to your keen sense of what motivates people.
Requirements: Milani
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Sense Motive skill checks, and Sense Motive is always a class skill for you.

texts.9ed43443734f445e9928f90e:
You, or perhaps your family, were once worshipers of Iomedae, but something happened that made you lose your faith. Perhaps your family was accused of being dishonorable or cowardly, or maybe one of your family members was the victim of church “justice.” Or perhaps you simply met someone who opened your eyes and showed you the truth—that the Inheritor’s so-called honor, valor, and justice are just tin plating on a strict dogma that seeks to control people by restricting their free will. In any event, you left the church, and as a result, your family was subjected to scorn and holier-than-thou disapproval. Ever since, you’ve vowed to some day get revenge against the church of Iomedae—and with the current situation brewing in Cheliax, you might finally have the opportunity.
Benefits: Choose one:
Against followers of Iomedae, including many (but not all) archons and angels, you gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls and weapon damage rolls, or you gain a +1 trait bonus on the save DCs of your spells.

Requirements: Lands of the Linnorm Kings
Benefits: You gain a +2 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks against fey creatures.
texts.dbfdca63932d291a4d0c8666: Once per day as a swift action, you can add a trait bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks you attempt before the beginning of your next turn.
texts.dcfd4bcf3c43e76acece2254:
Requirements: Lashunta

Benefits: Once per day as a swift action, you can add a trait bonus equal to your Intelligence modifier on Strength checks and Strength-based skill checks you attempt before the beginning of your next turn.
texts.dd878701db3edcc7e17e8561:
You are used to sailing in the terrible winds that roll out from the Eye of Abendego, and can apply the skills you’ve learned to any storm.
Requirements: The Shackles
Benefits: You treat wind effects as one wind force category less than they actually are, both for any personal checks you must make and for any you make to captain or steer a ship.
texts.dd94131fdcb22b938af0fad6:
You have a strong sense of self-preservation, believing it is more important to safely extract yourself from a fight that has turned hopeless than to stubbornly stand your ground and risk death—for when you’re dead, you can’t protect the innocent.
Benefits: When using the Withdraw action, both the first and second squares of your movement are not considered threatened by any opponents you can see, rather than just the first square.
texts.dff04df6182dd2b75c2a6756:
You do not fear the threat of lesser weapons.

Benefits: Whenever you provoke an attack of opportunity by firing a firearm, you gain a +1 trait bonus on the attack roll that provoked the attack of opportunity.
texts.e0699224adc1d4c232a0d571:
The legendary battle prowess of your ancestors ensures that you have a certain amount of innate martial skill.
Requirements: Faultspawn Tiefling Heritage
Benefits: You take a -2 penalty on attack rolls made with weapons with which you are not proficient instead of the normal -4.
texts.e32e9226baa71fe496f1f3b5:
Your time at the Grand Lodge of Absalom has served you well.

Requirements: Grand Lodge

Benefits: Choose either Knowledge (geography) or Knowledge (history). You gain a +1 trait bonus on all checks for the chosen skill, and the chosen skill becomes a class skill for you.
texts.e3f723f9c9ec84d6a6e9f59c:
You’ve trained with some of the best giantslayers out there, and have learned how to avoid the worst effects of a giant’s powerful attacks.

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Reflex saves. In addition, once per day, when a creature with the giant subtype successfully confirms a critical hit against you with a weapon or a slam attack (not a spell or special ability), you can roll with the attack. You take normal damage from the blow, as if the critical had not been confirmed. You must be aware of the attack and able to react to it—if you are denied your Dexterity bonus to AC, you can’t use this ability. If you are a dwarf or a gnome, you can use this ability twice per day.
texts.e587a99b53297b1f57ed6a38:
Your family was prominent before the rise of Thrune, but that legacy is now forgotten by all but you. You hold every Chelish government official (including Hellknights) personally responsible for your lost glory.
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack and damage rolls against these officials.
texts.e7a93253635d917718e17429:
You were trained by your family with a weapon passed down from a venerable ancestor.
Requirements: Shizuru
Benefits: You begin play with an heirloom masterwork weapon worth up to 400 gp.
You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls with weapons of this type (not just your initial heirloom weapon) when you smite evil.
texts.e872e49305ae6a4087df4ee1: #375 required note checked against the full pinned body at https://gitlab.com/foundryvtt_pathfinder1e/pf1-content/-/blob/02f4ab0d92e0d64f9eb2d127f42fd809cb23db7d/src/pf-traits/Marked_by_Nature_s_Magic__Skinwalker__Ots6NMyC4CQzKiP8.yaml; outputs follow the published text.
texts.e9fe1f85c7e247df4873b90b:
Born and raised a slave with no hope of advancement, you are adept at avoiding your overseer's ire and attention, the better to spend time on your own interests.
Requirements: Halfling
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Stealth checks and a +3 trait bonus on Bluff and Diplomacy checks to avoid punishment by lawful authority.
texts.ebd0259d7d298e692f7e6e36:
During your time on the Plane of Air, you visited the libraries of Armun Kelisk frequently and voraciously read the tomes therein.

Requirements: Plane of Air

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (planes) checks and checks made with one other Knowledge skill of your choice. This bonus increases to +3 when used to identify a creature with the air subtype. Knowledge (planes) becomes a class skill for you, and your bonus language options at 1st level include Auran. This choice is in addition to the bonus languages available to the character because of her race.
texts.ebd3aae2e93a9504ae08a908:
Your ancestors taught you the importance of using what nature provides.

Requirements: Yamasa

Benefits: You gain a +3 trait bonus on Survival checks when attempting to survive in the wilderness.
texts.ec42cbae3468d400e6a9511c:
You’re greatly skilled in hunting and slaying those who resemble your lord’s favored prey.

Requirements: Dahak

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on attack rolls against creatures of the dragon type.
texts.ecbb98926efcaeafd2972eec:
You trained with your clan to hunt large prey such as the dinosaurs of the Valashmai Jungle.

Requirements: Catfolk

Benefits: When you grant an ally a bonus on an attack roll against a foe of Large or larger size due to flanking or the aid another action, that ally gains a +1 trait bonus on weapon damage rolls against that creature as well.
texts.ecf0bf29bdbe46676c7262c1:
A master druid at the Grand Lodge revealed to you greater secrets of concentration when changing your form into that of an animal.
Requirements: Druid, Pathfinder Society
Benefits: Whenever you use your wild shape class ability to turn yourself into a Small or Medium-sized animal, the effect lasts for 2 hours per druid level instead of 1 hour per druid level.
texts.ed7972f8f40b1096d0b58eb1:
You have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge about the world and desire to obtain it firsthand.
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on all Knowledge (dungeoneering) and Knowledge (history) checks, and you may treat your caster level as 1 level higher for all conjuration spells of the teleportation subschool.
texts.edd913ead56330373a38cd12:
Using an ancient and painful surgical technique, you've reshaped your tongue. These surgical mutilations permit you to speak ancient words unpronounceable to most mortals, enhancing your ability to work magic associated with the Great Old Ones.

Requirements: Old Cults

Benefits: Any summoning or divination spell you cast to summon or contact a Great Old One or one of their minions is cast at +1 caster level.
texts.ee0523ab962c865851fd1bdd:
You have an innate talent for using magical weaponry and those weapons capable of becoming magical.

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Craft checks made to craft magic or masterwork weapons. In addition, when you use your arcane pool class ability to grant a weapon an enhancement bonus, that bonus lasts for 2 minutes instead of 1.
texts.efac47af57d17234792ea515:
As soon as you were old enough to hold it, you were trained to defend yourself with traditional Ulfen weapons.
Requirements: Ulfen Human Heritage
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on damage rolls with the following weapons: Bastard Sword, Battle Axe, greataxe, greatsword, handaxe, Light Hammer, longbow, longsword, shortbow, Shortsword, Throwing Axe, and warhammer.
texts.f16e5f05fe6a960f8e11c645:
Your upbringing in Hwanggot has influenced you to be both peaceful and wise, and your arguments are consistently sound.
Requirements: Hwanggot, Good Alignment
Benefits: You gain a +2 trait bonus on Diplomacy checks. You must be Lawful Good, Neutral Good, or Chaotic Good to take this trait.
texts.f237b088492200abda3726f9:
Numerous expeditions to accursed regions like Nidal’s Finder's Gulch have reinforced your already steadfast faith.
Requirements: Nidal
Benefits: Once per day, you may reroll a Will saving throw made against an attack or effect that originates from an undead creature. You must decide to use this trait after the first saving throw is rolled, but before the results are revealed. You must take the result of the second roll, even if it is lower.
texts.f252c263cb75e317634a55e6:
You make your way in life by putting people back together after the rigors of the world take their toll—brewing herbal remedies, setting broken bones, and treating diseases.

Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on all Heal and Knowledge (nature) checks, and one of these skills is always a class skill for you. Any time you restore hit points using the Heal skill or a cure spell (but not with channeled energy, lay on hands, or a magic device such as a potion or wand), you restore 1 additional hit point, plus 1 for every 2 class levels you have beyond 1st.
texts.f78abaa3c118432eecfc9287:
Although you live some distance from the city-state your community owes fealty to, you’ve been influenced by its sophisticated urban ways.

Requirements: Varisia

Benefits: Determine the city-state of which your home is a holding. You gain a +1 trait bonus on checks with one Profession skill and one of the following benefits.

Magnimar

Gain one random @UUID[Compendium.pf-content.pf-items.Item.IbSjz0hXs2E7TwoN]{Varisian Idol} (see page 15 of Varisia, Birthplace of Legends).
texts.fa6c86092e746dfbf4f9da56:
You always seem to be chased by drafts of moving air, and know exactly the right moment and method to lift yourself upon the breezes.

Requirements: Sylph

Benefits: As long as you get a running start, you gain a +2 trait bonus on Acrobatics checks made to jump. Your speed increases by 5 feet when you use the run action.
texts.fc9cc132f3b6b42154e34b26: Trait category (one trait per category), drawback and campaign-trait rules are checked by the sheet from traitType; nothing in this record changes them.
texts.fcc0121ba935c996a1cd690f:
Your fiendish heritage has made you more resilient to the many poisonous threats in wastelands.

Requirements: Tiefling

Benefits: You gain a +2 trait bonus on saving throws against contact and inhaled poisons, and a +3 trait bonus on saving throws against ingested poisons.
texts.fd60cea1c217f736b9b479e1:
After spending a month in the Mediogaltian jungle, you developed a knack for dealing with dinosaurs.
Requirements: Ilizmagorti
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus on Knowledge (nature) and Survival checks concerning dinosaurs. You also gain a +1 trait bonus on wild empathy checks made to affect dinosaurs.
texts.feca24ea18c6529e0edc0a81:
Your home community prides itself on remaining independent from Varisia’s city-states.
Requirements: Varisia
Benefits: Choose one of Varisia’s unaffiliated settlements from this list below. You gain a +1 trait bonus on Survival checks and one of the following benefits.
Arsmeril or Crying Leaf
Gain a +1 trait bonus on Perception checks made at night.
Special Note
This is one of five versions of this trait. Other versions can be found here:
Regional Recluse - Ilsurian (Varisia)
Regional Recluse - Sanos Forest or Whistledown (Varisia)
Regional Recluse - Turtleback Ferry (Varisia)
Regional Recluse - Urglin (Varisia)
texts.ff60eb0064eaf3b260de0db0:
Your grandiose posturing often makes it difficult for anyone to concentrate around you.

Requirements: Sovereign Court

Benefits: Once per day as a full-round action, you may attempt to distract adjacent foes with a lengthy display of your martial prowess. All adjacent foes must succeed at a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 your level + your Charisma modifier) or gain the shaken condition. This condition persists for 1 round.
texts.ff8e59645fee2638da06c271:
The Society gave you access to charts detailing the weak spots of hundreds of humanoids and monsters.
Requirements: Rogue, Pathfinder Society
Benefits: You gain a +1 trait bonus to damage rolls from sneak attacks.
